description: Views a workflow run by ID. Returns structured data with status, conclusion, jobs (with steps), and workflow details.

exitStatus.description: Exit with non-zero status if run failed (--exit-status)

job.description: View a specific job by ID (-j/--job)

logFailed.description: Retrieve logs for failed steps only (--log-failed)

path.description: Repository path. Authoritative — when omitted, the server uses its own process working directory (its launch dir, not the caller's cwd). Callers in a git worktree or other directory MUST pass this explicitly to avoid operating on the wrong repo.

repo.description: Repository in OWNER/REPO format (--repo). Default: current repo.

tailLines.description: With log/logFailed: return only the last N log lines, where test runners print failures and tracebacks. logsTotalLines then gives the full length

name: run-view
title: Run View
